integration_issues.issue: Sonner toasts render fixed at bottom-right (default) and can overlap the approve-fit-btn (also bottom-right of Fit panel). If the user clicks approve while a previous toast is still visible, the click may hit the toast instead of the button — this is the most likely explanation for the main agent's flaky report. Consider moving toasts to top-right OR raising approve-fit-btn z-index, OR dismissing toast before opening AlertDialog.

action_items: Consider repositioning Sonner toasts (top-right or top-center) OR give approve-fit-btn a higher z-index so a lingering toast never intercepts the click — this eliminates the flaky approve-click behaviour observed by main agent.
Optional: auto-dismiss any active toast when opening the approve AlertDialog (toast.dismiss() before setOpen(true)).

rca of the issue: Root cause of the main-agent's flaky 'direct approve after ack dialog did not approve' observation: Sonner's default toast position is bottom-right; the Fit panel places approve-fit-btn at bottom-right of the right column. The Sonner toast fired by the preceding approveFit() call (or by the ack-dialog's dismissal) can overlap the approve-fit-btn button geometry, so a subsequent click lands on the toast instead of the button. Mitigation: (a) toast.dismiss() before opening AlertDialog / after approval; or (b) move Sonner position to 'top-right' in the Toaster component; or (c) increase z-index of the Fit tab footer. Verified in this iteration by adding 4.5s waits — direct approve after ack-dialog flow succeeded reliably (fitApproved=true).
